name: Better LucX
description: Subscription extras the panel does not do itself: every AmneziaWG node also gets the amneziawg://<config> link INCY imports (for every client), CSQTT links are given in the plain form proxy clients read, and CSQTT and OpenFlux links get their inbound's remark as the name on the subscription page. Links of any scheme in the client form, OpenFlux in the subscription and the $name macro are the panel's own now. Switch it off and the panel does what it always did.
author: AllIsA1
